command:
set -e; mkdir -p /work/q4/official/benchmarks/cascadia; cd /work/q4/official/benchmarks/cascadia; cat > run.sh <<'BASH'
set -e
r.in.gdal --overwrite -o input=DATA/ca_elev.tif output=ca_elev
r.in.gdal --overwrite -o input=DATA/ca_avalanche.tif output=ca_avalanche
g.region -s raster=ca_elev
r.avaflow.40G -ae prefix=cascadia cellsize=20 aoicoords=4400,2200,1000,4000 phases=1 elevation=ca_elev hrelease=ca_avalanche density=2800 friction=35,15,-1000 cohesion=3.0 time=5,200
BASH
grass --tmp-location XY --exec bash run.sh
